LESSON: SIGN READING 5.2.1 VISUAL MEMORY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Sign reading 5.2.1 Visual memory
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 5.2.1 Visual memory, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which wild animals do you know? 2. Which are the dangerous wild animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 5.2.1 Visual memory together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: as learner recalls names of animals using pictures.

● Self-efficacy as learner correctly identifies names of wild animals observed during a visit to game park, watched on

media or seen on pictures.

Values:
● Unity: cooperation as leaner interacts positively with others in recalling names of animals.

● Responsibility: diligence as learner demonstrates love and care to wild animals that are not dangerous during a game

park visit.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Financial literacy as learner identifies the benefits of animals to the country and to us as individuals.

Link to other Activity Areas: as learner relates telling names of wild animals observed during a visit to a game park

with theme animals in religious activities.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures,

digital devices, online resources, relevant digital devices.
